name: claude-mods
description: Personal Claude Code mods: usage cockpit, subagent progress, file tree and ask-before-save memory.

plugins.name: cockpit
plugins.description: Usage band and panel, model and effort advisor, budget guard, /handoff, cache timer.

plugins.name: savvy-progress-plus
plugins.description: Progress bar for multi-step work and a /crew panel of subagents (fork of savvy-progress).

plugins.name: workspace
plugins.description: Read-only file tree pane (/tree) with marks on files Claude read, edited or created.

plugins.name: memory
plugins.description: Spots your preferences and asks before saving each one to CLAUDE.md.
